name: @openrig/studio-effects
description: Frame effects for the studio: a scanner-glass warp, with an analog-video and a tile-mosaic family to follow. Parameters are named for what a person perceives, so an agent can drive them from a description.
_dependencies_note: ffmpeg-static is used for ONE thing: remuxing a recorded clip to mp4. MediaRecorder writes WebM with no duration header, so the file is not seekable and is a poor source for a second scan - which is the whole reason for saving it. The transcode is optional at runtime: if the binary is absent the clip is kept as webm and the surface SAYS SO rather than pretending it succeeded.
